title: Venezuelan Beef Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy dish originating from Venezuela, featuring marinated beef skewers grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: Quick seared onions
ingredients.notes: sautéed in a pan with a bit of oil

ingredients.name: Skewer ingredients (bell peppers, onions, tomatoes, mushrooms)

instructions: Thread beef, onions, bell peppers, tomatoes, and mushrooms onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush skewers with Venezuelan Chimichurri sauce.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until beef reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with additional Chimichurri sauce on the side, if desired.
